Bent-arm pulling stays first: one heavy Weighted Pull-up day, one volume day, one ring muscle-up ladder day, and one quality-singles day. Planche and Handstand Push-up stay in, but the straight-arm dose is capped so it supports the goals instead of spending the elbow budget.

Weeks 2-3 nudge pull-up load up and stretch the muscle-up work toward a triple attempt only if the doubles stay clean. Week 4 is consolidation: same key movements, fewer total sets, so you keep the strength and skill while finishing fresher.

If the left medial elbow rises above 2/10 or is still worse after 48 hours, remove straight-arm rows in this order: Sat Band-Assisted Straddle Planche, Sat Advanced Tuck Planche, Wed Advanced Tuck Front Lever, Mon Advanced Tuck Planche. Keep bent-arm pulling unless symptoms clearly shift there; if a muscle-up rep turns soft or asymmetrical, end that row and continue only with the remaining prescribed bent-arm work.
